extension.summary: Weather from SMHI (Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute)
extension.description: Current conditions from up to five SMHI observation stations of your choice, each value taken from the first station that reports it, combined with SMHI's 10-day point forecast. Supports up to five locations in Sweden and the Nordic region.
extension.disclaimer: Weather data from SMHI Open Data (opendata.smhi.se), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0). This add-on is not affiliated with SMHI.
